set.typical_award_size: Optional incentive program within Sustainable Development Areas (sites zoned or designated for 20 or more units per acre, or within one-quarter mile of a rail station; SDMC 143.1002) replacing density limits with floor area ratio tiers (Tier 1 Downtown no FAR maximum, Tier 2 FAR 8.0, Tier 3 FAR 6.5, Tier 4 FAR 4.0, plus 1.5 FAR for family-sized units). Required (143.1015(a)): rental projects must restrict, excluding bonus units, 15 percent of units at 50 percent AMI rents plus 10 percent at 60 percent AMI plus 15 percent at 120 percent AMI (40 percent total), or alternatively 40 percent at 50 percent AMI, 100 percent at 60 percent AMI, or 100 percent moderate (half at 80 percent AMI, half at 120 percent AMI); for-sale tiers are in 143.1016; naturally affordable units must be replaced. Section 143.1010(f): waiver of Development Impact Fees for all covenant restricted affordable units, up to 30 percent of units of 500 square feet or less (if at least 10 percent are three bedroom units), and three bedroom units restricted at or below 150 percent AMI, when the project reaches at least 120 percent of base maximum density. Neighborhood Enhancement Fee (Resolution R-313282; about $9.00 per square foot of lot area per the program page) or a public space on sites of 25,000 square feet or more; the fee is waived only when 100 percent of units (excluding managers units) are restricted at or below 50 percent AMI (143.1010(g)). reason: SDMC 143.1015 requires a 40 percent combined set-aside (or an alternative) and 143.1010(g) waives the Neighborhood Enhancement Fee only for projects 100 percent at or below 50 percent AMI, so the record understated the affordability requirement and overstated the fee waiver.

set.typical_award_size: Requirement, not a subsidy. Applies to developments of five or more units. Local enhancements adopted March 6, 2018 (Housing SD): 10 percent density bonus for projects within the permitted building footprint, incentives or waivers available without requesting a bonus, 100 percent density bonus for micro-units within the footprint, and bonuses for sites with existing or recently expired rent restricted units. State bonuses up to 50 percent (80 percent or unlimited for 100 percent affordable) apply. ADU Home Density Bonus (SDMC 141.0302(d)): within a Sustainable Development Area one bonus ADU for each deed restricted affordable ADU with no fixed cap; outside a Sustainable Development Area a maximum of one bonus ADU and one affordable ADU; not available in RS-1-1 to RS-1-4 and RS-1-8 to RS-1-11 zones unless the site is High or Highest Resource and designated Residential; a Community Enhancement Fee applies. Permitting: 2,619 homes under the density bonus in 2024 (8,726 in 2021 to 2024); 653 ADUs under the ADU bonus in 2024 (892 in 2021 to 2024, 41 percent affordable). SDHC charges land use application fees (adjusted November 1, 2025).
